mapper.insert: insert into employee( employee_no, account_no, employee_type, employee_htime ) values( #{employeeNo}, #{accountNo}, #{employeeType}, #{employeeHtime} )
mapper.select: select a.account_no, a.account_id, a.account_name, a.account_phone, a.account_status, a.account_utime, a.account_type, e.employee_no, e.employee_type, e.employee_htime from account A join employee e on a.account_no = e.account_no where a.account_id = #{accountId} and a.account_type = '직원'
mapper.update: update account set account_name = #{accountName}, account_phone = #{accountPhone}, account_utime = systimestamp where account_no = #{accountNo}
mapper.select: select e.employee_no, a.account_name, a.account_id, a.account_phone, e.employee_type, e.employee_htime, e.employee_status, a.account_status from employee e join account a on e.account_no = a.account_no order by a.account_name asc

select e.employee_no, e.employee_type, e.employee_htime, e.employee_status, a.account_no, a.account_id, a.account_birth, a.account_name, a.account_phone, a.account_status, a.account_type, a.account_utime from employee e join account a on e.account_no = a.account_no where e.employee_no = #{employeeNo}
mapper.update: update employee set employee_status = '재직' where employee_no = #{employeeNo} and employee_status = '대기'
mapper.select: Select E.employee_no, A.account_name, A.account_id, A.account_no from employee E join account A on A.account_no = E.account_no where A.account_name like #{accountName} || '%' order by A.account_name asc, E.employee_no asc
mapper.update: update account set account_status = 'Y' where account_no = ( select account_no from employee where employee_no = #{employeeNo} )

update employee E
set E.employee_status = '재직'
where E.employee_status = '대기'
and exists (
select 1
from employment_contract C
where C.employee_no = E.employee_no and C.contract_status = 'active' and C.signed_time is not null )

update account A
set A.account_status = 'Y'
where A.account_status != 'Y'
and exists (
select 1
from employee E
join employment_contract C on C.employee_no = E.employee_no
where E.account_no = A.account_no and E.employee_status = '재직' and C.contract_status = 'active' and C.signed_time is not null )
